neighbours.label: A word inside the spelled-out expansion of an acronym or organization name ('Federal Emergency Management Agency', 'Drop Everything And Read')
fire: FEMA stands for the Federal Emergency Management Agency, which coordinates disaster relief.
Every Friday the class has DEAR time, which means Drop Everything And Read for twenty minutes.
The WHO, or World Health Organization, issued new guidance on the outbreak last week.
She joined NASA, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, right after college.
Our school is a member of the PTA, the Parent Teacher Association, in our county.
The report was written by the GAO, the Government Accountability Office, in March.
He works for UNICEF, the United Nations Children's Fund, in a regional office.

quiet: The agency coordinates disaster relief whenever a federal emergency is declared by the president.
Every Friday the class drops everything and reads quietly for twenty minutes before lunch.
Health officials around the world issued new guidance on the outbreak last week.
She joined the national space program right after college and worked on rockets.
Parents and teachers at our school meet once a month to plan events in our county.
The report on government spending was written by a team of auditors in March.
He works for a children's charity funded by several nations in a regional office.
Adults in the community can take evening classes at the education center downtown.
